blocks.translation: Clear Date

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Content / Story

blocks.source: 販売：マーベラスエンターテイメント、開発：イメージエポック。中小メーカー製としては、今時珍しい王道かつ大作ＲＰＧ。
blocks.translation: Published by Marvelous Entertainment and developed by Imageepoch. For a game from a small-to-mid-sized developer, this is an unusually traditional, full-scale RPG for its time.

blocks.source: シナリオライターはテイルズオブシンフォニア＆ジアビスと同じ人（実弥島 巧氏）。パーティトーク（テイルズにおけるチャット）を始め、狙ってやってるのかという程、色々とこの２作と同じ臭いがする。
blocks.translation: The scenario writer is the same person who worked on Tales of Symphonia and Tales of the Abyss (Takumi Miyajima). From the party talks (the equivalent of skits in Tales) onward, so many things resemble those two games that you might wonder whether it was intentional.

blocks.source: ヒロインは教会に所属。歌によって術を行使する。この能力が物語のカギとなる。
blocks.translation: The heroine belongs to a church and uses songs to cast spells. This ability becomes key to the story.

blocks.source: 国家間の対立の狭間で、主人公達が色々と立ちまわる。
blocks.translation: The protagonists maneuver in various ways amid conflicts between nations.

blocks.source: 物語中盤のログレス集め。テイルズにおける精霊集めに該当。順序に若干の自由あり。
blocks.translation: The collection of Logres in the middle of the story. This corresponds to collecting spirits in Tales. The order is somewhat flexible.

blocks.source: といった具合。上２つはジアビス。下はシンフォニアとの共通点。
blocks.translation: That is the general idea. The top two are common points with The Abyss. The bottom one is a common point with Symphonia.

blocks.source: 新鮮味はないかもしれないけど、元々この２作はシナリオ評価が高い部類なので、一応の安定感がある。中年キャラがカッコいいお陰か、話のノリは若干テイルズよりも落ち着いている感じ。ジアビスに良く似て、各キャラクターが色々な思惑を抱えており、仲間内での対立が多い。物語は一筋縄ではいかず、先の展開が気になる作りになっている。
blocks.translation: It may not feel fresh, but these two games were already considered to have highly rated scenarios, so there is at least a certain sense of stability. Perhaps thanks to the cool middle-aged characters, the tone feels somewhat calmer than Tales. Much like The Abyss, each character has various motives, leading to frequent conflicts within the group. The story does not unfold predictably, making you curious about what happens next.

blocks.source: ただ、それにしても終盤の展開はちょっとベタ過ぎかも。テイルズオブシリーズを何作かクリアしたというプレイヤーなら、食傷気味に感じる箇所があるかと思う。上記２作以外にも、デスティニー２やラタトスクの騎士（シンフォニアの続編。実弥島氏はシナリオ原案の模様）辺りとも、カブっているせいで激しく既視感が……。
blocks.translation: Even so, the developments toward the end may be a little too clichéd. Players who have cleared several Tales games may find some parts tiresome. In addition to the two games mentioned above, it also overlaps with titles such as Destiny 2 and Dawn of the New World (the sequel to Symphonia; Miyajima appears to have provided the original story concept), resulting in an intense sense of déjà vu...

blocks.source: クエスト等（お使いだけど……）の要素もあって、終盤はサブイベントもそこそこある。『ネームドモンスター』といって、手強い敵との戦いも用意されている。
blocks.translation: There are also quest-like elements (mostly errands, though...), and a fair number of side events toward the end. Battles against tough enemies called "Named Monsters" are also included.

blocks.source: 戦闘時の声の掛け合いが地味に細かくて面白い。回復を掛けた相手の性別で、反応を変えるサージュとか。攻撃する相手によって、専用セリフがある敵キャラとか。
blocks.translation: The small details in the characters' battle banter are amusing. For example, Serge's reaction changes depending on the gender of the person he heals. Some enemies also have unique lines depending on whom they attack.

blocks.source: 筆者のクリアまでは５５時間。全滅によるロスがそこそこあるので、実質的にはもう少し多いかも。全体的にダンジョンは短めでも、ボス戦に時間が掛かる。隠しダンジョンもあるけど、後述するボス戦の長さに耐えかねて断念。
blocks.translation: It took me 55 hours to clear the game. There are a fair number of setbacks from party wipes, so the actual time may have been somewhat longer. Although the dungeons are generally on the short side, boss battles take time. There is also a hidden dungeon, but I gave up because I could not bear the length of the boss battles described below.

blocks.source: システム／バランス／快適性
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance / Comfort

blocks.source: 戦闘
blocks.translation: Battle

blocks.source: 戦闘システムは、行動するキャラクターを切り替えながら戦うというもの。行動はパーティ全体で共有するＡＰ（毎ターン溜まる行動ポイント）が０になるまで複数回可能。同じキャラクターばかりを行動させることもできる。
blocks.translation: The battle system involves switching between characters as they act. Actions can be performed multiple times until the AP shared by the entire party (action points accumulated each turn) reaches zero. You can even have the same character act repeatedly.

blocks.source: なかなか戦略性は高いが、クラシックコントローラでは、キャラクターの切替にＬＲボタンを使用するのが、ちょっとやり辛い。個人的には←→キーがよかったと思う。
blocks.translation: The system offers considerable strategic depth, but using the L and R buttons to switch characters with the Classic Controller is somewhat awkward. Personally, I think the left and right buttons would have been better.

blocks.source: 術技は少し時間が掛かるものの、使用頻度の高い通常攻撃はスピーディ。オートにすれば、弱いザコ戦は数十秒で決着が付く。しかし、ボス戦は長引くと、何十分と掛かることも。どうも、回復アイテム（１種類９９個まで持てる。蘇生も楽々）の使用を前提にバランス調整しているのか、攻め手に掛ける場合は延々と長引きやすい。また、ＭＰの制限は非常に厳しいので、ザコ戦で光召術（魔法）は使い辛い。
blocks.translation: Although techniques take a little time to execute, the frequently used normal attacks are fast-paced. With the game set to auto, weak enemy encounters are settled within a few dozen seconds. However, boss battles can take dozens of minutes if they drag on. It seems the balance was adjusted around the use of healing items (you can carry up to 99 of each type, and reviving is easy), so battles tend to drag on endlessly when you lack offensive power. Also, MP restrictions are extremely strict, making light spells difficult to use against ordinary enemies.

blocks.source: 傾向として、ザコ敵と比較してボス敵が非常に強い。シンボルエンカウントだが、道中のザコ敵をひたすら倒して鍛えていても、ボス戦では苦戦させられる。（後半はザコ敵も結構強い）
blocks.translation: As a general tendency, bosses are extremely strong compared with ordinary enemies. Although the game uses symbol encounters, even if you relentlessly defeat ordinary enemies along the way to train, boss battles will still give you a hard time. (Ordinary enemies also become fairly strong in the latter half.)

blocks.source: 勝利するためには、ボスの弱点や攻撃を調べた上で、対策を取らなければ厳しい。それ自体は上等だけど、問題は全滅＝ゲームオーバーなのに、ボス戦前にセーブポイントがないのが珍しくないこと。そのため、ボスにとりあえず全滅覚悟で当たってみて、戦略を練って再挑戦するという方法を取り辛い。
blocks.translation: To win, you need to investigate a boss's weaknesses and attacks and prepare accordingly. That in itself is fine, but the problem is that a total party wipe means Game Over, while it is not uncommon for there to be no save point before a boss battle. As a result, it is difficult to simply challenge a boss expecting to get wiped, devise a strategy, and try again.

blocks.source: 敵の経験値にはレベルによる補正が掛かっており、こちらのレベルより低い敵を倒しても、貰える経験値が下がる。レベル上げによるゴリ押しが難しいので、ライトユーザーには、あんまり優しくなさそう。
blocks.translation: Enemy EXP is adjusted according to level, so defeating enemies below your level yields less EXP. Since brute-forcing your way through by leveling up is difficult, the game does not seem particularly friendly to casual players.

blocks.source: 戦闘システム・バランス自体は、それなりに練り込まれており光る所も多い。ただ、問題はボス戦の長さにプレイヤーが耐えられるかどうか。下手を打てば、１戦闘に１時間以上掛かる事もあるので、それで全滅したら心が折れること間違いなし。特にゲーム後半はボス戦の回数が多く、強いボスも多いのでとても疲れた。誇張ではなく、筆者のプレイ時間の半分程度はボス戦と、その準備・経験値稼ぎに費やされた。
blocks.translation: The battle system and balance themselves are fairly well-developed, with many strong points. The question is whether players can tolerate the length of the boss battles. If things go badly, a single battle can take more than an hour, so getting wiped afterward is sure to break your spirit. The second half in particular was exhausting, with many boss battles and many strong bosses. This is not an exaggeration: roughly half of my playtime was spent on boss battles, preparing for them, and grinding for EXP.

blocks.source: 強化システム
blocks.translation: Enhancement System

blocks.source: 武器にピースをはめ込む事で、カスタマイズが可能。ＦＦ７のマテリアとＦＦ９の装備アビリティを合わせて複雑化したようなシステムで、ピースがこのゲームにおけるスキルに当たる。新しく手に入った武器は最初、何らかのピースが固定されているが、戦闘を重ねて武器レベルを上げることで、取り外しできるようになる。ピースの組み合わせ次第で、同じキャラクターであっても、『攻撃役』『壁役』『支援役』というように役割を変えることができて面白い。
blocks.translation: Weapons can be customized by inserting pieces into them. The system is like a more complicated combination of FFVII's Materia and FFIX's equipment abilities, with pieces serving as this game's skills. Newly acquired weapons initially have some piece fixed in place, but after repeated battles raise the weapon's level, the pieces can be removed. Depending on the combination of pieces, it is fun that the same character can take on different roles, such as an attacker, tank, or support character.

blocks.source: ただし、武器を変更する場合、ピースを引き継いでくれないので、手動で付け替える必要がある。また、武器レベルがＭＡＸになると、強力な武器固有スキルを発動できるようになるが、それ以上の成長は望めないので、育成時は別の武器に変えておく必要がある。
blocks.translation: However, when changing weapons, the pieces are not carried over, so you must equip them again manually. Also, once a weapon reaches MAX level, it can activate a powerful weapon-specific skill, but it cannot grow any further, so you need to switch to another weapon while developing your characters.

blocks.source: 戦闘に参加しなかった仲間について、経験値は手に入るが、武器は成長しない。新しい武器のピースを取り外すには、装備できるキャラを戦闘に出す必要がある。しかし、武器を育てるために、育成用の編成でダンジョン攻略していた場合、そのままボス戦に突入してしまって積むことがある。
blocks.translation: You gain EXP for allies who did not participate in battle, but their weapons do not grow. To remove pieces from a new weapon, you must put a character who can equip it into battle. However, if you have been clearing dungeons with a training-oriented party to develop weapons, you may enter a boss battle with that party still in place and end up stuck.

blocks.source: 以上より結局、筆者のプレイスタイルは……
blocks.translation: Ultimately, this led to my play style being...

blocks.source: 育成用の編成で、レベルと武器レベルを上げる。
blocks.translation: Raise levels and weapon levels with a training-oriented party.

blocks.source: 攻略用の編成で、一気にダンジョンを攻略し、ボスを撃破する。
blocks.translation: Use a party assembled for clearing content to quickly clear the dungeon and defeat the boss.

blocks.source: というものに落ち着いた。
blocks.translation: That was what I settled on.

blocks.source: 育成用と攻略用のキャラの切替は手間が掛かる。今時のＲＰＧなら普通はダンジョン攻略しながら、自然にキャラを成長させられる様になっているけれど、それらと比較して、ゲーム進行はスムーズとは言い難い。後半は敵のレベルが跳ね上がるので、それに合わせて長時間のレベル上げを強いられる。
blocks.translation: Switching between characters for training and those for dungeon progression is a hassle. In modern RPGs, you can usually develop your characters naturally while clearing dungeons, but compared with those games, it is hard to call the progression smooth. Since enemy levels jump sharply in the latter half, you are forced to spend a long time leveling up accordingly.

blocks.source: しかも、攻略用の編成をしていても、ボス戦直前にシナリオの都合で、勝手にパーティ編成が替わってしまう場合がある。せめて、一度メニュー画面を開いてくれればマシなのだけど、そういった配慮はない。正直、攻略情報を見ながらプレイしないと大変。
blocks.translation: Moreover, even when you have assembled a party for dungeon progression, the party may be changed automatically for story reasons immediately before a boss battle. It would at least be better if the game opened the menu screen once, but it offers no such consideration. Honestly, playing without referring to a walkthrough is difficult.

blocks.source: ストーリーの都合によって、序盤はメンバーの入れ替わりが激しい。ゲスト参戦のキャラクターを除いて、結局２名の離脱者が出る。一応、離脱者の武器は、後で加入したキャラが同じ種類の武器を使えるという配慮がされている。
blocks.translation: For story reasons, the party changes frequently early on. Excluding guest characters, two members ultimately leave the party. As a small concession, characters who join later can use the same types of weapons as the departing members.

blocks.source: その他・快適性関連
blocks.translation: Other Comfort-Related Features

blocks.source: 町は移動速度の割にやや広め。広めというよりも、町の構造が意地悪といった方が正確かも。例えば、主人公が住む帝都では『主人公の家』『ギルド』『城』といった何度か立ち寄る施設が奥に配置されている。それ程、何度も何度も行ったり来たりさせられるわけではないけれど。
blocks.translation: The towns are somewhat large relative to the movement speed. More precisely, their layouts are needlessly inconvenient rather than simply large. For example, in the imperial capital where the protagonist lives, frequently visited facilities such as the protagonist's house, the guild, and the castle are located at the back. Still, you are not forced to go back and forth quite that many times.

blocks.source: ロード時間に付いては、戦闘・マップ切替共に気にならないレベル。メニュー画面も一瞬で開くので快適。
blocks.translation: Loading times are short enough not to be noticeable, both in battles and when switching maps. The menu screen also opens instantly, making the game comfortable to play.

blocks.source: カメラワークはちょっと微妙。視点は固定なのだが、ダンジョン探索時に手前側に移動する場合の視野が狭く、敵シンボルを回避し辛い。それと、飛光艇（空の乗物）の操作も後退ができないので、細かな調整がやり辛い。
blocks.translation: The camera work is somewhat mediocre. Although the viewpoint is fixed, your field of vision is narrow when moving toward the foreground while exploring dungeons, making it difficult to avoid enemy symbols. Also, the flying lightship (an airborne vehicle) cannot move backward, making fine adjustments difficult.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Visuals

blocks.source: 時代を考えると、パッとしない部類かも。Ｗｉｉなので、ＰＳ３の作品の様な高水準を期待してはならない。もっとも、個人的にはＰＳ１時代の粗いポリゴンと比較すれば、何の問題もないレベル。戦闘アニメーションなどは結構派手で見応えもある。
blocks.translation: Considering its era, they may be somewhat underwhelming. Since it is a Wii game, you should not expect the high standards of a PS3 title. Personally, though, compared with the rough polygons of the PS1 era, the visuals are perfectly acceptable. The battle animations are fairly flashy and impressive.

blocks.source: キャラクターイラストもゲーム中で見ると意外と違和感はなかった。どうでもいいけど、主人公はイラストよりも、ゲーム内の通常シーンの方がイケメンな気がする。
blocks.translation: The character illustrations also did not feel as out of place as I expected when seen in the game. Not that it matters, but I feel the protagonist looks more handsome in the game's regular scenes than in the illustrations.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: 作曲はクロノトリガーやゼノギアス等と同じ光田康典氏。序盤の曲はちょっと地味に感じたが、後半はダンジョン曲・イベント曲等で話を盛り上げる。飛光艇の曲なども結構良いと思う。
blocks.translation: The composer is Yasunori Mitsuda, who also composed Chrono Trigger, Xenogears, and other titles. The early-game music felt a little understated, but the second half builds excitement with dungeon themes, event themes, and more. I also think the music for the flying airship is quite good.

blocks.source: 雑感
blocks.translation: General Impressions

blocks.source: 現代は新規ブランドの王道ＲＰＧが少ないので、こういう作品がもっと増えて欲しいと思う今日この頃。
blocks.translation: There are few traditional RPGs from new brands these days, so lately I’ve been wishing there were more games like this.

blocks.source: しかし、初週売上３万本に届かずと、作品の規模に対して売上に乏しい模様なのが悲しい。Ｗｉｉでは任天堂以外の作品が売れ辛いという要因もあったのかと思う。しかし、Ｗｉｉの作品にしては、そこらのＰＳ２～３のＲＰＧよりも、ライトユーザー殺しの要素が多いのは辛い。
blocks.translation: However, it’s sad that sales apparently fell short of 30,000 copies in the first week, which is poor compared to the scale of the game. I wonder if the fact that titles from publishers other than Nintendo struggled to sell on the Wii was also a factor. Still, for a Wii game, it’s tough that it has more elements that shut out casual players than the run-of-the-mill PS2 and PS3 RPGs.

blocks.source: その点をまとめると……
blocks.translation: To summarize these points…

blocks.source: レベル補正による経験値減少によって、レベルを上げてのゴリ押しができない。特にラスボスはきつい。それがなくとも、後半の敵の経験値はさほど高くない。まるでメガテンシリーズの様な調整方。
blocks.translation: The experience reduction caused by level scaling prevents you from brute-forcing your way through by simply leveling up. The final boss is especially tough. Even without that, the enemies in the latter half don’t give particularly much experience. The balancing is much like that of the Megami Tensei series.

blocks.source: イベント中のハマリ防止の意味もあるが、ボス戦前にセーブポイントがないことがある。
blocks.translation: Although this also helps prevent you from getting stuck during events, there are times when there is no save point before a boss battle.

blocks.source: ボス戦が非常に時間が掛かる。回復アイテムで延々と粘れば、中々全滅しない。下手すれば１時間オーバーも。それで結局、全滅したら気持ちが萎える事請け合い。
blocks.translation: Boss battles take an extremely long time. If you keep healing with recovery items, it’s hard to get wiped out. In some cases, they can last over an hour. Then, if you ultimately get wiped out, it’s practically guaranteed to crush your spirit.

blocks.source: ガンガン強くなる味方。ラスボスに楽勝できる程度までは余裕で強くなる。
blocks.translation: Your allies become tremendously powerful. They have no trouble growing strong enough to beat the final boss with ease.

blocks.source: セーブを宿屋限定の『通常セーブ』と、どこでもできる『クイックセーブ』に分けてハマリ防止。
blocks.translation: To prevent you from getting stuck, saves are divided into “regular saves,” which are limited to inns, and “quick saves,” which can be made anywhere.

blocks.source: ボス戦は勝つか全滅するかの短期決戦。長くても数十分程度で決着。
blocks.translation: Boss battles are short, decisive fights where you either win or get wiped out. Even the longest battles are settled within a few dozen minutes.

blocks.source: というように配慮されていることを考えると、もう少しやりようがあったんじゃないかと思えてくる。新規ブランドのＲＰＧとしては、中々見所も多いので、ちょっと惜しい。
blocks.translation: Considering these sorts of accommodations, I can’t help thinking that they could have handled things a little better. For an RPG from a new brand, it has quite a lot going for it, which makes it all the more regrettable.

texts.販売：マーベラスエンターテイメント、開発：イメージエポック。中小メーカー製として: Published by Marvelous Entertainment and developed by Imageepoch. For a game from a small-to-mid-sized developer, this is an unusually traditional, full-scale RPG for its time.
texts.シナリオライターはテイルズオブシンフォニア＆ジアビスと同じ人（実弥島 巧氏）。パ: The scenario writer is the same person who worked on Tales of Symphonia and Tales of the Abyss (Takumi Miyajima). From the party talks (the equivalent of skits in Tales) onward, so many things resemble those two games that you might wonder whether it was intentional.
texts.ヒロインは教会に所属。歌によって術を行使する。この能力が物語のカギとなる。: The heroine belongs to a church and uses songs to cast spells. This ability becomes key to the story.
texts.国家間の対立の狭間で、主人公達が色々と立ちまわる。: The protagonists maneuver in various ways amid conflicts between nations.
texts.物語中盤のログレス集め。テイルズにおける精霊集めに該当。順序に若干の自由あり。: The collection of Logres in the middle of the story. This corresponds to collecting spirits in Tales. The order is somewhat flexible.
texts.といった具合。上２つはジアビス。下はシンフォニアとの共通点。: That is the general idea. The top two are common points with The Abyss. The bottom one is a common point with Symphonia.
texts.新鮮味はないかもしれないけど、元々この２作はシナリオ評価が高い部類なので、一応の: It may not feel fresh, but these two games were already considered to have highly rated scenarios, so there is at least a certain sense of stability. Perhaps thanks to the cool middle-aged characters, the tone feels somewhat calmer than Tales. Much like The Abyss, each character has various motives, leading to frequent conflicts within the group. The story does not unfold predictably, making you curious about what happens next.
texts.ただ、それにしても終盤の展開はちょっとベタ過ぎかも。テイルズオブシリーズを何作か: Even so, the developments toward the end may be a little too clichéd. Players who have cleared several Tales games may find some parts tiresome. In addition to the two games mentioned above, it also overlaps with titles such as Destiny 2 and Dawn of the New World (the sequel to Symphonia; Miyajima appears to have provided the original story concept), resulting in an intense sense of déjà vu...
texts.クエスト等（お使いだけど……）の要素もあって、終盤はサブイベントもそこそこある。: There are also quest-like elements (mostly errands, though...), and a fair number of side events toward the end. Battles against tough enemies called "Named Monsters" are also included.
texts.戦闘時の声の掛け合いが地味に細かくて面白い。回復を掛けた相手の性別で、反応を変え: The small details in the characters' battle banter are amusing. For example, Serge's reaction changes depending on the gender of the person he heals. Some enemies also have unique lines depending on whom they attack.
texts.筆者のクリアまでは５５時間。全滅によるロスがそこそこあるので、実質的にはもう少し: It took me 55 hours to clear the game. There are a fair number of setbacks from party wipes, so the actual time may have been somewhat longer. Although the dungeons are generally on the short side, boss battles take time. There is also a hidden dungeon, but I gave up because I could not bear the length of the boss battles described below.
texts.戦闘システムは、行動するキャラクターを切り替えながら戦うというもの。行動はパーテ: The battle system involves switching between characters as they act. Actions can be performed multiple times until the AP shared by the entire party (action points accumulated each turn) reaches zero. You can even have the same character act repeatedly.
texts.なかなか戦略性は高いが、クラシックコントローラでは、キャラクターの切替にＬＲボタ: The system offers considerable strategic depth, but using the L and R buttons to switch characters with the Classic Controller is somewhat awkward. Personally, I think the left and right buttons would have been better.
texts.術技は少し時間が掛かるものの、使用頻度の高い通常攻撃はスピーディ。オートにすれば: Although techniques take a little time to execute, the frequently used normal attacks are fast-paced. With the game set to auto, weak enemy encounters are settled within a few dozen seconds. However, boss battles can take dozens of minutes if they drag on. It seems the balance was adjusted around the use of healing items (you can carry up to 99 of each type, and reviving is easy), so battles tend to drag on endlessly when you lack offensive power. Also, MP restrictions are extremely strict, making light spells difficult to use against ordinary enemies.
texts.傾向として、ザコ敵と比較してボス敵が非常に強い。シンボルエンカウントだが、道中の: As a general tendency, bosses are extremely strong compared with ordinary enemies. Although the game uses symbol encounters, even if you relentlessly defeat ordinary enemies along the way to train, boss battles will still give you a hard time. (Ordinary enemies also become fairly strong in the latter half.)
texts.勝利するためには、ボスの弱点や攻撃を調べた上で、対策を取らなければ厳しい。それ自: To win, you need to investigate a boss's weaknesses and attacks and prepare accordingly. That in itself is fine, but the problem is that a total party wipe means Game Over, while it is not uncommon for there to be no save point before a boss battle. As a result, it is difficult to simply challenge a boss expecting to get wiped, devise a strategy, and try again.
texts.敵の経験値にはレベルによる補正が掛かっており、こちらのレベルより低い敵を倒しても: Enemy EXP is adjusted according to level, so defeating enemies below your level yields less EXP. Since brute-forcing your way through by leveling up is difficult, the game does not seem particularly friendly to casual players.
texts.戦闘システム・バランス自体は、それなりに練り込まれており光る所も多い。ただ、問題: The battle system and balance themselves are fairly well-developed, with many strong points. The question is whether players can tolerate the length of the boss battles. If things go badly, a single battle can take more than an hour, so getting wiped afterward is sure to break your spirit. The second half in particular was exhausting, with many boss battles and many strong bosses. This is not an exaggeration: roughly half of my playtime was spent on boss battles, preparing for them, and grinding for EXP.
texts.武器にピースをはめ込む事で、カスタマイズが可能。ＦＦ７のマテリアとＦＦ９の装備ア: Weapons can be customized by inserting pieces into them. The system is like a more complicated combination of FFVII's Materia and FFIX's equipment abilities, with pieces serving as this game's skills. Newly acquired weapons initially have some piece fixed in place, but after repeated battles raise the weapon's level, the pieces can be removed. Depending on the combination of pieces, it is fun that the same character can take on different roles, such as an attacker, tank, or support character.
texts.ただし、武器を変更する場合、ピースを引き継いでくれないので、手動で付け替える必要: However, when changing weapons, the pieces are not carried over, so you must equip them again manually. Also, once a weapon reaches MAX level, it can activate a powerful weapon-specific skill, but it cannot grow any further, so you need to switch to another weapon while developing your characters.
texts.戦闘に参加しなかった仲間について、経験値は手に入るが、武器は成長しない。新しい武: You gain EXP for allies who did not participate in battle, but their weapons do not grow. To remove pieces from a new weapon, you must put a character who can equip it into battle. However, if you have been clearing dungeons with a training-oriented party to develop weapons, you may enter a boss battle with that party still in place and end up stuck.
texts.以上より結局、筆者のプレイスタイルは……: Ultimately, this led to my play style being...
texts.育成用の編成で、レベルと武器レベルを上げる。: Raise levels and weapon levels with a training-oriented party.
texts.攻略用の編成で、一気にダンジョンを攻略し、ボスを撃破する。: Use a party assembled for clearing content to quickly clear the dungeon and defeat the boss.
texts.というものに落ち着いた。: That was what I settled on.
texts.育成用と攻略用のキャラの切替は手間が掛かる。今時のＲＰＧなら普通はダンジョン攻略: Switching between characters for training and those for dungeon progression is a hassle. In modern RPGs, you can usually develop your characters naturally while clearing dungeons, but compared with those games, it is hard to call the progression smooth. Since enemy levels jump sharply in the latter half, you are forced to spend a long time leveling up accordingly.
texts.しかも、攻略用の編成をしていても、ボス戦直前にシナリオの都合で、勝手にパーティ編: Moreover, even when you have assembled a party for dungeon progression, the party may be changed automatically for story reasons immediately before a boss battle. It would at least be better if the game opened the menu screen once, but it offers no such consideration. Honestly, playing without referring to a walkthrough is difficult.
texts.ストーリーの都合によって、序盤はメンバーの入れ替わりが激しい。ゲスト参戦のキャラ: For story reasons, the party changes frequently early on. Excluding guest characters, two members ultimately leave the party. As a small concession, characters who join later can use the same types of weapons as the departing members.
texts.町は移動速度の割にやや広め。広めというよりも、町の構造が意地悪といった方が正確か: The towns are somewhat large relative to the movement speed. More precisely, their layouts are needlessly inconvenient rather than simply large. For example, in the imperial capital where the protagonist lives, frequently visited facilities such as the protagonist's house, the guild, and the castle are located at the back. Still, you are not forced to go back and forth quite that many times.
texts.ロード時間に付いては、戦闘・マップ切替共に気にならないレベル。メニュー画面も一瞬: Loading times are short enough not to be noticeable, both in battles and when switching maps. The menu screen also opens instantly, making the game comfortable to play.
texts.カメラワークはちょっと微妙。視点は固定なのだが、ダンジョン探索時に手前側に移動す: The camera work is somewhat mediocre. Although the viewpoint is fixed, your field of vision is narrow when moving toward the foreground while exploring dungeons, making it difficult to avoid enemy symbols. Also, the flying lightship (an airborne vehicle) cannot move backward, making fine adjustments difficult.
texts.時代を考えると、パッとしない部類かも。Ｗｉｉなので、ＰＳ３の作品の様な高水準を期: Considering its era, they may be somewhat underwhelming. Since it is a Wii game, you should not expect the high standards of a PS3 title. Personally, though, compared with the rough polygons of the PS1 era, the visuals are perfectly acceptable. The battle animations are fairly flashy and impressive.
texts.キャラクターイラストもゲーム中で見ると意外と違和感はなかった。どうでもいいけど、: The character illustrations also did not feel as out of place as I expected when seen in the game. Not that it matters, but I feel the protagonist looks more handsome in the game's regular scenes than in the illustrations.
texts.作曲はクロノトリガーやゼノギアス等と同じ光田康典氏。序盤の曲はちょっと地味に感じ: The composer is Yasunori Mitsuda, who also composed Chrono Trigger, Xenogears, and other titles. The early-game music felt a little understated, but the second half builds excitement with dungeon themes, event themes, and more. I also think the music for the flying airship is quite good.
texts.現代は新規ブランドの王道ＲＰＧが少ないので、こういう作品がもっと増えて欲しいと思: There are few traditional RPGs from new brands these days, so lately I’ve been wishing there were more games like this.
texts.しかし、初週売上３万本に届かずと、作品の規模に対して売上に乏しい模様なのが悲しい: However, it’s sad that sales apparently fell short of 30,000 copies in the first week, which is poor compared to the scale of the game. I wonder if the fact that titles from publishers other than Nintendo struggled to sell on the Wii was also a factor. Still, for a Wii game, it’s tough that it has more elements that shut out casual players than the run-of-the-mill PS2 and PS3 RPGs.
texts.レベル補正による経験値減少によって、レベルを上げてのゴリ押しができない。特にラス: The experience reduction caused by level scaling prevents you from brute-forcing your way through by simply leveling up. The final boss is especially tough. Even without that, the enemies in the latter half don’t give particularly much experience. The balancing is much like that of the Megami Tensei series.
texts.イベント中のハマリ防止の意味もあるが、ボス戦前にセーブポイントがないことがある。: Although this also helps prevent you from getting stuck during events, there are times when there is no save point before a boss battle.
texts.ボス戦が非常に時間が掛かる。回復アイテムで延々と粘れば、中々全滅しない。下手すれ: Boss battles take an extremely long time. If you keep healing with recovery items, it’s hard to get wiped out. In some cases, they can last over an hour. Then, if you ultimately get wiped out, it’s practically guaranteed to crush your spirit.
texts.ガンガン強くなる味方。ラスボスに楽勝できる程度までは余裕で強くなる。: Your allies become tremendously powerful. They have no trouble growing strong enough to beat the final boss with ease.
texts.セーブを宿屋限定の『通常セーブ』と、どこでもできる『クイックセーブ』に分けてハマ: To prevent you from getting stuck, saves are divided into “regular saves,” which are limited to inns, and “quick saves,” which can be made anywhere.
texts.ボス戦は勝つか全滅するかの短期決戦。長くても数十分程度で決着。: Boss battles are short, decisive fights where you either win or get wiped out. Even the longest battles are settled within a few dozen minutes.
texts.というように配慮されていることを考えると、もう少しやりようがあったんじゃないかと: Considering these sorts of accommodations, I can’t help thinking that they could have handled things a little better. For an RPG from a new brand, it has quite a lot going for it, which makes it all the more regrettable.
